exercise_ref.answer: as long as — I’ll lend you the car as long as you don’t drive too fast. The loan is conditional on safe driving. Equivalent: I won’t lend you the car unless you drive safely.

questions.q: (Despite / Although) the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.

context.it: Usa il testo corretto editorialmente mostrato qui.
context.en: Use the editorially corrected wording shown here.

explanation.it: The heavy traffic è un sintagma nominale: richiede despite. Although introduce invece una proposizione, per esempio although the traffic was heavy.
explanation.en: The heavy traffic is a noun phrase, so it takes despite. Although introduces a clause, for example although the traffic was heavy.

citations.quote: (Despite / Although) the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.

exercise_ref.source_q: (Despite / Although) the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
exercise_ref.source_answer: Although — followed by a clause (the heavy traffic alone would need despite; here the sentence has a noun phrase, so Despite is also acceptable: Despite the heavy traffic). Best single answer for a clause: if the original read the heavy traffic, choose Despite. → Despite the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
exercise_ref.q: (Despite / Although) the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
exercise_ref.answer: Despite — Despite the heavy traffic, we arrived on time. Despite is followed by the noun phrase the heavy traffic; although would need a clause such as although the traffic was heavy.
